fixture_note: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Invented genes, invented diseases, invented sequences and numbers. Exists to exercise the workflow's gates, scoring, checkpoint, and structural comparison. It is not scientific evidence and must never be cited as a finding.

sources.name: Synthetic dependency fixture
sources.notes: Invented gene-effect values for testing gate and scoring behaviour.

sources.name: Synthetic interaction fixture
sources.notes: Invented target-partner interaction records spanning several target and partner classes.

sources.name: Synthetic normal-tissue fixture
sources.notes: Invented normal-cell expression and dependency proxies.

sources.name: Synthetic structural fixture
sources.notes: Invented sequences and domain boundaries for structural testing.

evidence.claim: TGTDEMOA shows a strong selective dependency in synthetic epithelial carcinoma models (median gene effect -1.05) relative to all other lineages (-0.12).
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOA
limitations: Synthetic values; no experimental measurement underlies them.
Gene-effect scores are computed from a screen model, not observed phenotypes.

evidence.claim: 83% of synthetic epithelial carcinoma models are dependent on TGTDEMOA, versus 6% of other models.
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOA

evidence.claim: Crosslinking mass spectrometry in a synthetic fixture places TGTDEMOA residues 22-33 in direct contact with the PTNDEMO1 core, identifying the interacting region rather than only the association.
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOA-PTNDEMO1
limitations: A mapped crosslink is not a solved interface structure.

evidence.claim: TGTDEMOE co-precipitates with PTNDEMO3 in a synthetic whole-protein pull-down. The pull-down used full-length protein and identifies no interacting region.
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOE-PTNDEMO3
limitations: A whole-protein pull-down reports association, not a contact point.
No interacting region is mapped, so there is nothing to model or screen.

evidence.claim: TGTDEMOF is strongly overexpressed in synthetic colorectal models relative to matched normal tissue (log2 fold change 4.2).
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOF
limitations: Overexpression is not evidence of dependency.

evidence.claim: Despite strong overexpression, TGTDEMOF shows no dependency signal in synthetic colorectal models (median gene effect -0.18, indistinguishable from other lineages at -0.11).
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOF

evidence.claim: TGTDEMOE shows a strong selective dependency in synthetic melanoma models (median gene effect -0.98 versus -0.15 elsewhere).
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOE

evidence.claim: TGTDEMOA expression is low in synthetic normal epithelial tissue panels.
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOA
limitations: Expression is not a safety measurement.

evidence.claim: Synthetic normal-cell proxy models show no dependency on TGTDEMOA (median gene effect -0.04).
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOA
limitations: Proxy models are not normal tissue.

evidence.claim: Two of the eighteen synthetic epithelial carcinoma models show no TGTDEMOA dependency despite high TGTDEMOA expression, so expression does not predict dependency within the context.
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOA
limitations: Small subgroup; no mechanism is implied.

evidence.claim: The TGTDEMOA interacting region and the PTNDEMO1 binding domain are each defined as bounded synthetic sequence regions suitable for complex modelling.
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOA-PTNDEMO1
limitations: Synthetic sequences; no experimental structure exists.

evidence.claim: TGTDEMOB is required in 91% of all models across every lineage tested, consistent with a broadly essential gene rather than a selective dependency.
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOB

evidence.claim: TGTDEMOB associates with PTNDEMO1 in a synthetic pulldown fixture.
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOB-PTNDEMO1

evidence.claim: TGTDEMOC shows a selective dependency in synthetic neuroendocrine models (median gene effect -0.88 versus -0.21 elsewhere).
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOC

evidence.claim: TGTDEMOC is speculated to contact PTNDEMO2 because both appear in a synthetic co-expression module, with no assay and no primary record supporting a physical interaction.
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOC-PTNDEMO2
limitations: Co-membership in a module is not evidence of a physical interaction.

evidence.claim: TGTDEMOD shows a moderate selective dependency in synthetic sarcoma models (median gene effect -0.72 versus -0.19 elsewhere).
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOD

evidence.claim: A synthetic peptide array maps TGTDEMOD residues 41-52 as the fragment retained by PTNDEMO2.
evidence.subject: TGTDEMOD-PTNDEMO2
limitations: A peptide array tests isolated fragments, not the intact proteins.

candidates.hypothesis: In synthetic epithelial carcinoma models, the selective dependency on TGTDEMOA is carried by its interaction with PTNDEMO1, making that interface a candidate point of intervention. FIXTURE HYPOTHESIS: synthetic data, no scientific claim.

limitations: A mapped region is not the same as a solved interface structure.

notes: Synthetic sequences created for this fixture.
No experimental structure exists for an invented protein.

candidates.hypothesis: TGTDEMOB is required in synthetic epithelial carcinoma models. FIXTURE HYPOTHESIS: included to confirm that broadly essential genes are rejected whatever class the target belongs to.

notes: Not assessed; the candidate fails the dependency gates.

candidates.hypothesis: TGTDEMOC may act through PTNDEMO2 in synthetic neuroendocrine models. FIXTURE HYPOTHESIS: included to confirm that an interaction nobody measured cannot advance.

limitations: No assay, no primary record, no support value.

candidates.hypothesis: TGTDEMOF is overexpressed in synthetic colorectal models and may drive them. FIXTURE HYPOTHESIS: this is the negative control named in PROJECT.md — overexpression with no dependency signal. It must be rejected out loud.

notes: Not pursued; there is no dependency to explain.

candidates.hypothesis: TGTDEMOE may act through PTNDEMO3 in synthetic melanoma models. FIXTURE HYPOTHESIS: this is the negative control named in PROJECT.md — a strong selective dependency whose partner link rests only on a whole-protein pull-down with no interacting region mapped. It must be rejected out loud.

limitations: Whole-protein pull-down; no interacting region is mapped.
Association is not a contact point.

notes: No contact point mapped, so there is nothing to model.

candidates.hypothesis: TGTDEMOD may depend on its contact with PTNDEMO2 in synthetic sarcoma models. FIXTURE HYPOTHESIS: included to confirm that missing evidence lowers completeness without being scored favourably.

limitations: A peptide array tests isolated fragments, not the intact proteins.

notes: No sequences supplied; structural tractability is unassessed.
